name: @better-compute/audit
description: Tamper-evident audit for better-compute: signed hourly per-tenant Merkle checkpoints over audit_events, inclusion proofs and verification.

name: better-compute
description: Manage GPU and bare-metal capacity and provision nodes in many ways: one package with every better-compute subpath.

name: @better-compute/capacity
description: Capacity for better-compute: atoms, bookings, quotas, rollups and the placement pipeline.

name: @better-compute/cli
description: The better-compute command line.

name: @better-compute/client
description: Typed, browser-safe client for the better-compute API.

name: @better-compute/console-kit
description: Framework-free view models for better-compute consoles: resource stores with pagination, live event refresh and permission-aware actions.

name: @better-compute/core
description: Browser-safe contracts for better-compute: domain types, errors, state tables, extension contracts and the IAM catalog.

name: @better-compute/driver-sdk
description: bcx, the better-compute out-of-process driver protocol: serveDriver runs a defineDriver object as a plugin, externalDriver hosts one over auto-mTLS gRPC.

name: @better-compute/events
description: Event delivery for better-compute: per-tenant signed webhooks with retries and dead letters, and the SSE /watch stream, read from the outbox.

name: @better-compute/fleet
description: FleetConfig as code for better-compute: export, plan and apply sites, pools, offers, quotas, flavors and provider accounts.

name: @better-compute/gateway
description: The better-compute gateway: daemon sessions over gRPC/HTTP/2 mTLS, liveness, command dispatch and Join/Renew/Secret forwarding.

name: @better-compute/gcp-common
description: Shared Google Cloud plumbing for better-compute: token sources, workload identity, REST client, errors, paging, operations

name: @better-compute/iam
description: The better-iam bridge for better-compute: IAM plugin and catalog, event inbox, authz projection and resolver, the embedded IamPort, usage sink and flag cache.

name: @better-compute/inventory
description: Hardware inventory for better-compute: section hashing, diffs, GPU model mapping, labels and health conditions.

name: @better-compute/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol tools for better-compute: pools, capacity, GPU reservations and node status for AI agents, gated by better-iam.

name: @better-compute/metal
description: Bare-metal lifecycle for better-compute: power, management, boot, deploy and inspect drivers.

name: @better-compute/observability
description: Metrics for better-compute: a bounded Prometheus registry, the standard better_compute_* series, a metered IamPort and backlog gauges.

name: @better-compute/pki
description: Machine PKI for better-compute: local CAs, SPIFFE node certificates, sealed join tokens, signed join responses and renew proofs.

name: @better-compute/postgres
description: PostgreSQL and PGlite storage for better-compute: executor, migrations and store conformance.

name: @better-compute/protocol
description: Wire contracts between the bcd daemon and the better-compute control plane (protobuf-es generated).

name: @better-compute/provider-digitalocean
description: DigitalOcean provider for better-compute: Droplets as VPS instances and offers, VPC networks, power, reinstall and discovery.

name: @better-compute/provider-gcp
description: Google Compute Engine provider for better-compute: VMs as VPS instances and offers, attach, reservations and tenant networks.

name: @better-compute/provider-hetzner
description: Hetzner providers for better-compute: Hetzner Cloud servers as VPS instances and offers.

name: @better-compute/provider-kubernetes
description: Kubernetes as a capacity source for better-compute: bcd as a DaemonSet adopts a cluster's nodes and GPUs into a pool.

name: @better-compute/provider-proxmox
description: Proxmox VE provider for better-compute: QEMU VMs cloned from templates as VPS instances.

name: @better-compute/provision
description: Provisioning for better-compute: profiles, steps and the workflow engine.

name: @better-compute/rollout
description: Signed bcd releases and wave rollouts (A/B self-update) for better-compute, within each pool's disruption budget.

name: @better-compute/server
description: The better-compute control plane: betterCompute(), the operation envelope, router and runtimes.

name: @better-compute/testing
description: Testing kit for better-compute: fixtures, simulated daemons, sim clock and conformance runners.

name: @better-compute/vps
description: VPS instances for better-compute: runtimes, flavors and external providers.
